article_title: Learn about the Freelancer Service Fee
excerpts: Learn how the Upwork Freelancer Service Fee works. See examples of fee calculations, refunds, discounts, and special cases like Direct Contracts.
What is the Freelancer Service Fee?
How is the Freelancer Service Fee set?
How will I know what the Freelancer Service Fee is for a job?

If money is refunded to my client do I get my Freelancer Service Fee back?
Is there a way to get a discount on the Freelancer Service Fee?
Does everyone pay the Freelancer Service Fee?
What is the Freelancer Service Fee?

It’s the fee you pay on your Upwork earnings. The fee ranges from 0% to 15% per contract, and helps us provide you with payment protection, fraud prevention, dispute resolution, and all the tools that help you run your business more smoothly.
How is the Freelancer Service Fee set?

The Freelancer Service Fee is set based on factors that help support a balanced and competitive environment across different types of work. Once your contract begins, the fee is fixed and won’t change.
How will I know what the Freelancer Service Fee is for a job?
Can you show me examples of how the Freelancer Service Fee works?

The Freelancer Service Fee can vary per contract and our built-in rate calculator estimates your net pay (after the fee) to help you bid accurately. We charge the client the exact billing rate you enter, but at times rounding may occur.
Example: You want to take home $20 USD per hour after the Freelancer Service Fee. If your fee is 10%, you’ll want to charge the client $22.22 USD per hour.
Your client is charged $266.64 USD (12 hours x $22.22)
The 10% fee is $26.664 USD or $26.66 USD when rounded down to nearest cent
Your net earnings are $239.98 USD ($0.02 less than estimated, 12 x $20 = $240 USD)
Example: You want to take home $25 USD per hour after the Freelancer Service Fee. If your fee is 10%, you’ll want to charge the client $27.78 USD per hour.
Your client is charged $333.36 USD (12 hours x $27.78 USD)
The 10% fee is $33.336 USD or $33.34 USD when rounded up to nearest cent
Your net earnings are $300.02 USD ($0.02 more than estimated, 12 x $25 USD = $300 USD)
No. Once a proposal, offer, or contract is sent, the Freelancer Service Fee is locked in and won't change. The fee can vary for different contracts though.
If money is refunded to my client do I get my Freelancer Service Fee back?
If your client is refunded—either by you or through our payment protection—we’ll return the Freelancer Service Fee you paid on that amount.

Example: Let’s say $100 that was paid to you is returned to the client and your Freelancer Service Fee was 10%. Since we charged you the 10% fee ($10) on those earnings, we will refund that $10 service fee to you. This way you aren’t paying fees on money you didn’t keep.
Is there a way to get a discount on the Freelancer Service Fee?
Does everyone pay the Freelancer Service Fee?
Upwork Payroll: Freelancers participating in the Upwork Payroll service are paid through a third-party staffing firm and are therefore excluded from paying an Upwork Freelancer Service Fee.

Any Hire: If you work for a client on an Any Hire contract, you will not pay a Freelancer Service Fee. These contracts are negotiated with the individual client who either met the freelancer off Upwork or paid the conversion fee to work with a freelancer found on Upwork's Marketplace.
Direct Contracts: If you have created a Direct Contracts contract with a client you brought to Upwork, you’ll pay a reduced Freelancer Service Fee. Learn more here.

Enterprise: If you're working with an Enterprise client, your service fee might look a little different. Typically, freelancers partnered with Enterprise clients pay a 10% service fee. But since Enterprise relationships are customized, your exact rate depends on the specific terms agreed to when the client joined the program. How long does it take to receive a payment through the Direct to Local Bank option?

Once you have Direct to Local Bank set up as your withdrawal method on Upwork, any withdrawals should arrive within four business days. If not, contact your bank for the status. After eight business days, we can attempt to trace the payment.

Note: There is a 12:00 pm (noon) UTC cutoff time for same-day processing. After that, transfers will be processed the following business day. Bank holidays in the U.S. or your country can delay your funds.

The cost per withdrawal direct to your local bank is $0.99 USD (plus incoming fees at some banks). Sending funds in your local currency may reduce or eliminate incoming bank fees.

article_title: About Connects: costs, uses, balances, and expiration
excerpts: Connects are virtual tokens that freelancers and agencies use to pursue work and promote their services on Upwork. This overview explains where Connects are used, how balances work, and where to find more detailed help.
Freelancer and agency balances are separate
You choose a bid and budget. Connects are charged for eligible client interactions while your profile is promoted.

Responding to an invitation does not deduct Connects. However, some new freelancers must first make a qualifying Connects purchase or join Freelancer Plus before they can submit any marketplace proposal, including one in response to an invitation.
Connects cost $0.15 USD each. They are sold in bundles, and a custom amount may also be available on the purchase page.
You may purchase or earn any number of Connects on your freelancer account.
Unused freelancer Connects roll over; there is no monthly freelancer rollover limit.

Always review the total shown immediately before you submit. If the requirement changes while you are preparing a boosted proposal, part of your total bid may be applied to the updated base proposal cost.
History: Open Connects history to review credits and deductions from the past 7, 30, or 90 days.
Connects Hub: Open Connects to know your current balance, review your Connects history, check your stats and trends, and see all the opportunities you got to earn Connects.
Freelancer and agency balances are separate
A freelancer balance and an agency balance are separate, even when the same person owns both accounts.
Freelancer proposals and promotions use the freelancer balance.
Connects cannot be moved between freelancer and agency accounts through self-service.

article_title: How expedited payments for freelancers in Ukraine work
excerpts: Expedited hourly payments for freelancers in Ukraine explained, including eligibility, timing, delays, and why fixed-price contracts aren’t included.
Who’s eligible for expedited payments in Ukraine?
How do expedited payments for freelancers in Ukraine work?
It’s Friday here and I don’t see my payment in my Upwork account even though I'm eligible for expedited payments for Ukraine. Why?
Why does my account show a payout date of next Wednesday instead of five days earlier, on Friday, when I'm eligible for expedited payments for Ukraine freelancers?
Will all payouts for Ukraine be accelerated, and are there any instances when they wouldn’t be?
Why don't expedited payments for Ukraine apply to fixed-price contracts?
Who’s eligible for expedited payments in Ukraine?
To help support our freelance community in Ukraine, we’re offering expedited payments on hourly contracts for all talent who have a tax/profile address there and an account in good standing.
How do expedited payments for freelancers in Ukraine work?

As long as your client’s billing method can be charged successfully and they don’t dispute your hours, we’ll apply their payment to your Upwork account five days earlier if you reside in Ukraine—which means on Fridays by 11:59 p.m. UTC.

Once the payment's applied, you can withdraw your money anytime you prefer by selecting Withdraw now. You can do this even if you have an automatic payment schedule set up and want your earnings sooner. You won't have to change your regular payment schedule.
Learn more about how payments for hourly contracts work and more about how to withdraw earnings.
Remember, we apply the payments on Friday by 11:59 p.m. UTC, so consider the difference in time zone when looking for your available payments.
It’s Friday here and I don’t see my payment in my Upwork account even though I'm eligible for expedited payments for Ukraine. Why?

Cleared payments are released on Fridays by 11:59 p.m. UTC. If you live in another time zone, please calculate the time difference to determine when your payment will be available. We'll also email you after your payment is applied and ready to be withdrawn.
Why does my account show a payout date of next Wednesday instead of five days earlier, on Friday, when I'm eligible for expedited payments for Ukraine freelancers?

Your official payment date will continue to show as Wednesday. This is because we won’t know which payments will be released early until we review accounts every Friday morning (if your client disputes your hours or their payment fails, we can’t release your payment until the issue is resolved).

As long as there’s no issues, your payment will be posted to your Upwork account on the Friday before the Wednesday date that is listed. For example, if your payment date is listed as Wednesday, March 23, you will receive it on Friday, March 18.
Will all payouts for Ukraine be accelerated, and are there any instances when they wouldn’t be?
Only hourly payments are eligible for faster payouts.
For hourly contracts, if your client disputes your hours or their billing method cannot be successfully charged, your payment will be delayed.

excerpts: Ensuring a safe community for everyone is a top priority at Fiverr. To facilitate secure business practices, we require freelancers to verify their identity. This process helps us build a trusted marketplace and protects your account from unauthorized access.

Identity verification helps keep the Fiverr marketplace trustworthy and secure. Completing these steps may be required to publish your Gigs in the Fiverr Catalog. Some new freelancers may also be required to pay a one time fee to complete ID verification. This fee covers the cost of verifying your identity through our verification partner. If you're enrolled in Seller Plus Kickstart, ID verification is included as part of your membership at no ex
New freelancers may be required to complete these steps before their Gigs can be added to the Fiverr Catalog.

The verification process follows a specific sequence. You can track your progress on your Talent Dashboard. To access it, navigate to your Talent Dashboard by clicking on "Dashboard" from your freelancer profile.
Enter your country and phone number.
Select your ID country and document type.
Enter the country in which your business is registered.

Enter your business entity name, business email, business phone number, address, and business registration number. Check out our article Business Registration Number Information by Country for detailed guidance.
Ensure the issuing country you select in the menu matches the country on your ID.

Retention: We retain the selfie for 60 days and your ID document for 30 days. After this period, we only retain essential details such as your name, date of birth, gender, hashed ID number, document type, and document country.

Phone verification: For clients, no. Your phone number is never displayed on Fiverr. For freelancers, your phone number is typically not displayed. It will only appear to an EU client viewing your profile, as required by the EU Digital Services Act (DSA).
You must verify your identity with a valid government-issued ID from the list of documents available for your country. If you are a minor, please read more about our Minor's Policy.

Add at least one high-quality image that clearly represents your service. If possible, include a short video showcasing your work, as Gigs with videos tend to perform better. For written-word services, a PDF with samples or reviews is a good option.

A guide to understanding Contra's discovery score.
What is the discovery score?

Your discovery score is an indicator of your reputation on Contra. The higher your score, the greater your visibility on the Discover search page. As your visibility increases, so do your chances of receiving inbound messages from clients and landing high-tier jobs.
Because Discover is constantly evolving, your score may adjust over time. It’s designed to give you a clear and actionable view into how your presence on Contra translates to visibility with Clients.
What contributes to the discovery score?
Your Discovery Score is calculated on several factors that are weighted differently based on their importance to your reputation.
How can I boost my discovery score?

Payment for your contributions will be made no less than 7 days after the pull request is deployed to production to allow for [regression](https://github.com/Expensify/App/blob/main/contributingGuides/CONTRIBUTING.md#regressions) testing.
